_about: Dated changes to real exams that a bank must follow. The /admin Questions tab lists each event as upcoming (within 60 days) or due (date passed, not marked done). Add one with every new exam whose outline, law or format is known to change, and set done to the date the bank was updated. Checked in CI by tools/check_freshness.py. Every exam is also due for a full review 365 days after its bank last changed (lib/landingDates.json).

events.what: The NCVEC 2027-2031 General (Element 3) question pool replaces the 2023-2027 pool.
events.action: Parse the new pool into tools/next100/hamgeneral/pool.json, write explanations for new or changed questions, rebuild, and update the landing, facts and CLAUDE.md.

events.action: Check the first 2027 ΕΟΠΠΕΠ call for any change to the 20-question theory part or the 1 to 20 grading.

events.what: SOR/2025-70 amended CARs Part IX in two stages (1 April and 4 November 2025): Level 1 Complex certificate and lower-risk BVLOS, medium RPA to 150 kg, sheltered and EVLOS for advanced pilots, basic operations redefined as uncontrolled airspace and 30 m at any altitude, micro drones at advertised events need an SFOC.
events.action: Bank written to the amended rules; re-check basic-operation items (CADRONE-LAW, -OPS, -AIR) against any further Part IX amendment or a new TP 15263 edition.

events.what: Apex API version 67.0 (Summer '26) made classes without a sharing keyword run with sharing, made Apex run in user context by default and disallowed WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED; the Visualforce guide still says custom controllers run in system mode.
events.action: Built with version-named questions on these defaults only. Recheck when Salesforce's Platform Developer exam guide names the release it aligns to.

events.what: Salesforce refreshed the Platform App Builder exam guide in August 2026 to the Summer '26 release: weights 18/20/32/17/13, 73% to pass (was 63%), deeper Flow and Agentforce as an automation tool.
events.action: Built to the refreshed guide from the start; nothing to change.

events.what: Decree 2026-764 removes the domestic professional-experience exemption for new VTC access applications.
events.action: Use the current access rule; distinguish pending files and European qualification recognition.

events.what: Providers start offering the 2027 AFTR course (for 2027 returns and the 2028 AFSP) from a new Publication 6079 outline, with 2027 inflation adjustments from the next revenue procedure.
events.action: Read the new Publication 6079 and 6012; move every 2026 figure (Rev. Proc. 2025-32 amounts, Notice 2026-10 mileage, 6695 amounts for returns filed in 2027, SALT $40,400 and $505,000) to the 2027 amounts, and update the landing, examFacts and the source dates.

events.what: VRF systems with a GWP above 700 built from components made before 2026 may no longer be installed (40 CFR 84.54(c)(2)); January 1, 2028 for projects with a building permit.
events.action: None for the bank (the EPA rules items already state these dates); re-read EPA's Technology Transitions page and check the dates still stand.

events.what: The disposable cylinder heel rule of 40 CFR 84.116 takes effect.
events.action: Check the rule is still in force before that date (the Emissions Reduction and Reclamation rule is under reconsideration; the May 2026 proposal covers refrigerated transport only) and update the cylinder items if it changed.

events.what: CTEC's updated CP23A qualifying education guidelines take effect, and courses move to tax year 2026 law (returns filed in 2027).
events.action: Read the new CP23A exhibit, then update every 2025 figure (standard deductions, credits, CalEITC and renter's credit limits, exemption credits, mileage) to the 2026 IRS and FTB amounts and add any new required topics.

events.what: Microsoft updates the English PL-900 exam on December 18, 2026 (notice on the certification page); until then the study guide lists the skills measured as of July 24, 2026.
events.action: Read the updated study guide's skills measured and change log, then re-weight the blueprint and add or retire items to match.

events.what: Help to Buy - Wales closes to new applications on 31 March 2027 unless extended again; CEMAP2-SCH-005 keys Wales as the only place a new buyer can still apply.
events.action: Check gov.wales; if the scheme has closed, rewrite CEMAP2-SCH-005.

events.what: ASPPB plans to make the integrated EPPP operational in the fourth quarter of 2027; Part 1 closes to first-time takers then and to all candidates on April 1, 2028 (EPPP Candidate Handbook, November 2026).
events.action: Check asppb.net for the launch date and the integrated EPPP blueprint; decide whether to rebuild the bank on the six-domain integrated outline or retire it after March 31, 2028; update the landing and examFacts.

events.what: APA's DSM page says revised DSM-5-TR criteria and text are expected in early 2027; APA's Ethics Code Task Force is also revising the Ethics Code.
events.action: Check psychiatry.org for DSM criteria changes and apa.org/ethics for an adopted code; fix any affected assessment, diagnosis and ethics items and the standard numbers cited in explanations.

events.what: SSVV usually updates the VCA-ETT eindtermen and the B-VCA toetsmatrijs each year (ETT 3.1 applied from 1 September 2026).
events.action: Read the new VCA-ETT and toetsmatrijs on ssvv.nl/examens, update affected items, the blueprint and the landing, record in tools/next100/nlvca/sources.md, rebuild.

events.what: New Wft eind- en toetstermen take effect (CDFD advice of 20 October 2026): Basis 1b.16 wording and 1f.39/1f.40 privacy wording; recheck the kenmerken.
events.action: Read the CDFD toetstermen and kenmerken for module Basis from 1 April 2027, update affected items and the landing, record in sources.md, rebuild.

events.what: ARRT's revised MRI Examination Content Specifications take effect (draft July 2026: Patient Care 20, Safety 40, Image Production 86, Procedures 54 of 200).
events.action: Read the approved 2028 specifications, re-weight the blueprint, pools and training sets, add the new safety topics, and update the landing, facts and docs.

events.what: NBCC's new NCMHCE specifications take effect: six new domains (Professional Development & Counselor Self-Awareness 15, Intake & Assessment 18, Treatment Planning & Continuity of Care 15, Provision of Counseling Interventions 20, Indirect Client Care 12, Legal & Ethical Compliance 20), 10 case studies, 130-150 questions, scaled 100-500 with 360 to pass.
events.action: Re-weight the blueprint and categories to the 2027 domains, add items for indirect client care and legal compliance, update the landing, examFacts and sources.md, rebuild.
